segments.name: Americas
segments.description: Sells supply chain commerce software, cloud subscriptions and implementation services to customers across North, Latin and South America.
segments.evidence: We have three reportable segments based on geographic location: North and Latin America ("the Americas"); Europe, Middle East and Africa ("EMEA"); and Asia Pacific ("APAC").

segments.name: EMEA
segments.description: Sells supply chain commerce software, cloud subscriptions and implementation services to customers across Europe, the Middle East and Africa.
segments.evidence: We have three reportable segments: the Americas, EMEA, and APAC.

segments.name: APAC
segments.description: Sells supply chain commerce software, cloud subscriptions and implementation services to customers in the Asia Pacific region.
segments.evidence: We manage our business by geographic segment and have three geographic reportable segments: the Americas (North, Latin and South America); Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA); and Asia Pacific (APAC).

revenueModel.text: Customers pay subscription fees for cloud-based supply chain and omnichannel software, and also pay for licenses, support, services and hardware.
revenueModel.evidence: We run our Manhattan Active® applications in the cloud and deliver them as subscription-based software as a service ("SaaS").
